verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents an official MCP server that lets users create indexes, add documents, configure settings (ranking rules, searchable attributes, faceting), and run searches through natural-language prompts in the AI client they already use. Conversational search adds natural-language querying of indexed content. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably, and documentation of coverage limits (which admin operations are not reachable via the MCP server, and that it depends on an external AI client).
